name: How can I prevent mold damage in my home after repairs are completed?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent mold damage in my home after repairs are completed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing future mold damage after repairs involves controlling moisture levels and ensuring proper ventilation throughout your home. This includes promptly fixing leaks, ensuring adequate attic and crawl space ventilation, and maintaining indoor humidity between 30-50%. In areas like bathrooms and kitchens, using exhaust fans during and after moisture-generating activities is crucial. AKN Design Group, as part of our commitment to lasting craftsmanship, can advise on design choices during a renovation that incorporate better moisture management, contributing to the enduring health and value of your property.
